baseline_models.focus_anchor: جاء من أقصا المدينة رجل يسعى ... يا قوم اتبعوا المرسلين
baseline_models.mechanism: A pedestrian crosses the city's maximum stated distance with directed effort, converts arrival into public speech, and tries to redirect his own group into the wake of message-carriers.

activation_trace.role: Coming reaches a scene and supplies the intervention's arrival event.
The farthest edge stretches the man's route across the city's spatial field.
The gathered built city makes the route a civic crossing rather than isolated travel.
Walking on foot gives the intervention bodily cost and self-propelled mobility.
Purposeful movement toward an objective makes the crossing intentional and urgent.
Audible utterance converts private motion into an address that can redirect others.
His own people are the social body whose direction he tries to change.
Following as trailing and taking guidance supplies the requested change of direction.
Message-carriers provide the persons and carried communication toward which he redirects the group.

changed_reading.before: A man happens to arrive from a distant neighborhood and gives advice.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a city-spanning intervention: costly directed movement becomes public speech intended to turn a whole group's course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: المدينة، رجل، يسعى، يا قوم، قال
baseline_models.mechanism: City-knowledge, earnest standing over a pressing affair, and the branch of oversight among a people combine into a local stakeholder who assumes responsibility for the city's decision.

activation_trace.role: The city-insider knowledgeable about its affairs turns location into civic competence.
Standing earnestly over an urgent affair supplies the man's posture of responsibility.
Oversight or service among a people makes his striving a civic function rather than speed alone.
Kin-group belonging gives him standing to address the threatened collective as his own.
Speaking together over an affair makes the address an attempted civic deliberation.

changed_reading.before: An anonymous runner adds another opinion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a city-competent stakeholder crosses from its edge to discharge responsibility for his people and reopen civic deliberation.

baseline_models.mechanism: Dispatch, successive movement, arrival, and following form a relay. Before commanding others to follow, the man bodily enacts entry into the moving sequence generated by the sent ones.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and release initiate movement from a sender toward recipients.
Successive groups make the plural sent ones a sequence capable of being extended.
The man's own arrival places another movement event after the dispatched sequence.
Directed striving makes his position in the relay enacted rather than merely verbal.
Unbroken succession renders following as joining an ordered chain.

changed_reading.before: Follow means mentally accept the messengers' claim.
changed_reading.after: Follow becomes embodied relay participation: the speaker's own directed arrival models how to enter the sequence he commends.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier hearers are imaged with constrained necks, barriers before and behind, covered sight, and failed seeing. Against that enclosure, the man from the extreme edge can move, arrive, perceive a needed intervention, and speak; the periphery becomes a reservoir of unblocked agency.

activation_trace.role: The extreme edge marks the outside point from which mobile agency enters.
Purposeful movement supplies the positive counter-image to enclosure.
A collar that binds an organ supplies bodily constraint in the audience image.
Barriers closing gaps before and behind produce a spatially sealed field.
A covering over the perceiver supplies occlusion within the sealed field.
Failed eyesight makes the audience's immobility perceptual as well as spatial.

structural_cues: 36:8-10 accumulates bodily restraint, front-and-back closure, and failed sight before 36:20 foregrounds arrival and striving.
The focus syntax begins with a motion verb and delays the moving subject, sharpening his contrast with the immobilized hearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: restraint, barriers, occlusion, and failed sight precede a man arriving from the edge in purposeful motion. Reader arrow: their enclosure makes his peripheral mobility a source of social and perceptual agency. Live alternative: 36:8-9 may describe receptivity only, without mapping onto the city's social geography.

changed_reading.before: The farthest-city phrase only measures how long the man ran.
changed_reading.after: The extreme edge is also a contrastive location of unblocked agency from which movement and insight penetrate a sealed center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The formal envoys arrive, are rejected, and are reinforced by a completing third; then a city man independently arrives and repeats their directional demand. He extends the relay as endogenous civic corroboration without being relabeled a messenger.

activation_trace.role: The knowledgeable city-insider image supplies local standing distinct from formal envoy status.
Message-carriers remain the objects of his imperative, preserving the distinction between witness and envoys.
The envoys' earlier arrival establishes the first movement in the relay.
The carried-message branch identifies the formal speakers whose claim needs corroboration.
Attribution of falsehood creates the credibility rupture answered by a local voice.
Explicit strengthening establishes reinforcement as an operative mechanism in the episode.
The completing third marks formal reinforcement before the different reinforcement supplied by the citizen.
The immediately repeated imperative carries the focus man's appeal forward as a sustained relay.
Gentle direction to the path supplies the positive basis on which the local witness corroborates following.

structural_cues: 36:13 and 36:20 repeat an arrival construction, first for the envoys and then for the man.
The man appears after formal reinforcement and hostile rejection, then 36:21 repeats اتبعوا without calling him one of the sent ones.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: envoy arrival, rejection, formal reinforcement, citizen arrival, and repeated following occur in sequence. Reader arrow: the citizen's locally grounded voice repairs a credibility rupture by corroborating the envoys. Live alternative: he may simply add persuasion, with no special evidentiary function.

changed_reading.before: The man merely echoes the outsiders' demand.
changed_reading.after: He becomes a distinct civic corroborator who carries the envoys' direction into the city's own voice while remaining outside their formal number.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following speech stresses that the envoys extract no compensation, then the speaker publicly commits himself and, after forgiveness and honor, still desires knowledge for his people. His striving is therefore other-directed expenditure and durable solidarity, not mere haste.

activation_trace.role: Striving for noble acts and reconciliation supplies a prosocial scope for his effort.
Calling them his own people anchors the effort in continuing communal solidarity.
Requesting or demanding supplies the extraction that the envoys explicitly do not perform.
Payment for work defines the compensation absent from their guidance.
Direction toward the path supplies a non-extractive benefit offered to the people.
Heart-settling assent makes the speaker personally stake himself on the appeal.
His people remain the object of concern even after his own outcome changes.
Desired disclosure to his people shows that their recognition, not private vindication, remains his aim.
Protective covering of fault supplies the benefit he wishes his people could recognize.
Honored generosity completes the non-extractive good toward which his effort points.

structural_cues: 36:21-25 continues the first-person appeal directly after the focus, moving from recommendation to personal commitment.
36:26-27 preserves يا ليت قومي as his orientation after forgiveness and honor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: no requested wage, guidance, first-person belief, and a later wish that his people know forgiveness and honor. Reader arrow: the continuous speaker's running is self-expenditure for communal rescue. Live alternative: يسعى may retain only locomotor urgency, with solidarity supplied solely by the later speech.

changed_reading.before: He hurries in order to deliver an urgent opinion.
changed_reading.after: His striving is a costly civic gift: he spends movement, voice, and personal exposure for people he continues to claim even after his own vindication.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated single cries abruptly terminate animation and ongoing dispute; afterward people cannot make a bequest or return, and finally all are brought present. The man's voluntary running and speaking occupy the narrowing interval in which direction can still be chosen.

activation_trace.role: Directed voluntary motion is the action whose temporal opportunity is at stake.
Articulated speech is the still-available act used to alter others' course.
A terrifying single cry supplies abrupt closure rather than gradual exhaustion.
Life or awareness stilled after movement supplies the terminal contrast to يسعى.
The repeated sudden cry generalizes closure beyond the first city episode.
Active disputation shows closure arriving while speech and contest are still underway.
Lost capacity marks the end of voluntary action.
An unmade transmitting testament is the speech-act no longer possible after closure.
Inability to return closes ordinary movement back toward one's people.
Compelled presence replaces the man's chosen arrival with universal brought-near attendance.

structural_cues: صيحة واحدة recurs at 36:29 and 36:49-53, linking local extinction and universal presentation through abrupt sound.
The sequence moves from the man's chosen arrival and utterance to inability to transmit, return, or choose one's attendance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: abrupt cries end movement and dispute, remove capacity for testament or return, and culminate in universal presence. Reader arrow: these closures compress يسعى وقال into a voluntary response window. Live alternative: the later eschatological sequence may provide analogy rather than the immediate chronology of the city event.

changed_reading.before: The man runs because the situation is generally urgent.
changed_reading.after: He spends the remaining voluntary interval: chosen movement, testimony, and redirected following occur before sound closes speech and all arrival becomes compulsory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus presents a man whose legs carry purposeful work into speech. Later mouths are sealed, hands speak, legs testify, and earning is exposed; then forward passage and return can be removed. The running body therefore becomes testimony before and beyond its verbal statement.

activation_trace.role: The leg contained within the man-image provides the limb later made an explicit witness.
Work and earning make his bodily striving an accountable deed rather than transport alone.
The literal hand becomes an alternative speaking organ when the mouth is closed.
Knowledge-bearing declaration gives bodily action evidentiary force.
The same root now explicitly names legs, activating the limb inside رجل in the focus.
Earning limbs connect what bodies do with what their testimony discloses.
Passage forward names the locomotor capacity that can be withdrawn.
Return names the opposite locomotor capacity that can likewise be withdrawn.

structural_cues: 36:20 orders bodily arrival and striving before قال; 36:65 reverses ordinary testimony by sealing mouths and letting limbs speak.
The root ر ج ل occurs as the whole man at 36:20 and as witnessing legs at 36:65.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: رجل/legs recur with striving, testimony, earning, and removable motion. Reader arrow: the man's chosen locomotion is itself pre-verbal witness to his alignment. Live alternative: رجل as person and أرجل as limbs may remain ordinary separate senses with no designed cross-activation.

changed_reading.before: His running only gets his mouth to the place where testimony can begin.
changed_reading.after: His legs already testify through what they earn: bodily movement is part of the witness, and the subsequent words articulate an alignment enacted on foot.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, human saying exhorts or disputes, the word becomes binding, and the closing divine command says to a willed thing 'be' and it occurs. The man's speech has force as a faithful civic relay that solicits voluntary following, not as autonomous performative authority.

activation_trace.role: His audible utterance is the human speech act whose level of efficacy is being located.
The carried-message image makes his utterance derivative relay rather than self-originating command.
A word becoming binding supplies realization at the level of settled obligation.
The repeated utterance root links the man's saying to the surah's binding word.
The opponent's articulated challenge shows that human saying can also resist rather than guide.
Command as demand and imposition supplies the authoritative level of the final speech act.
Will supplies the prior determination that directs the command toward a thing.
Saying is repeated at the point where utterance and realization meet.
Occurrence immediately follows the command and supplies the realized outcome unavailable to ordinary speech.

structural_cues: قال in the focus, قال in the creation challenge at 36:78, and يقول له كن فيكون at 36:82 place unlike speakers in one lexical chain.
The focus imperative asks humans to follow; the closing command is followed directly by occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: exhortative, resistant, binding, and immediately actualized sayings recur with different outcomes. Reader arrow: the man's saying is powerful through faithful relay and voluntary uptake, subordinate to the final performative command. Live alternative: the قول repetitions may provide rhetorical cohesion without a ranked theory of speech.

changed_reading.before: The man states an opinion with whatever persuasion his personality affords.
changed_reading.after: His saying is delegated civic transmission: it carries the sent message and opens voluntary response, while the surah reserves intrinsic realization for the final command.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the split س ع ي inventory's form-distant image of aimless release as a contrast, then connects social following to measured cosmic travel. It remains anchored in يسعى and اتبعوا and is supported by path, guidance, course, and orbit cues. Downstream prose should present it as a packet-induced polarity between directed striving and drift, not claim that يسعى lexically means wandering or that the man is a cosmic body.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful movement toward a goal supplies the directed pole of the contrast.
Aimless release and going on one's own face supplies the form-distant drift pole that directed striving overcomes.
Continuous succession makes following a maintained course rather than a momentary preference.
The straight road supplies an oriented route against which drift is legible.
Gentle direction toward a path confirms that the commended movement has guidance.
Flowing travel supplies a whole-surah analogue for sustained directed motion.
The celestial course supplies a bounded route within which movement remains ordered.
Running or swimming motion makes ordered travel dynamic rather than static alignment.

changed_reading.before: The man is simply moving quickly and asks for assent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he converts potential social drift into a guided course: his own purposeful travel models ordered following within a surah of measured trajectories.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping carried in the focus قول inventory. It remains anchored in قال, one رجل, and أقصى, while the context supplies the many who do not believe and recurring mockery. Downstream prose should call this a branch-level resonance of a scarce voice rising from the edge, not an etymological translation of قال.

activation_trace.role: Smallness and scarcity make the single utterance a minority voice against numerical weight.
Rising and taking up a load gives the scarce voice an upward, burden-bearing motion.
The singular man localizes the scarce voice in one exposed human speaker.
The extreme margin supplies the social-spatial point from which the minority utterance rises.
The many provide the numerical field against which a single counter-voice becomes salient.
Recurring mockery supplies the social pressure under which the scarce voice bears its load.

changed_reading.before: قال merely introduces what the man says.
changed_reading.after: At a contained branch level, the reporting verb also lights a scarce voice that rises from the city's margin and bears speech against the many.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the legal-consequential branches of تبع rather than its ordinary trailing sense. It remains anchored in the imperative اتبعوا and gains support from recorded deeds and traces, recompense, and earning. Downstream prose should describe a juridical resonance in choosing alignment, not assert that the imperative grammatically means incur liability.

activation_trace.role: A claimant pursuing a right gives following the pressure of an answerable claim.
An attaching consequence makes alignment carry an aftermath rather than end at imitation.
Work and earning make the speaker's own alignment an accountable activity.
Recorded establishment of a binding outcome supplies the juridical frame.
A remaining trace makes movement leave inspectable consequences behind it.
Recompense matching action makes chosen alignment consequential.
Acquired gain or deed supplies what the later bodily testimony answers for.

changed_reading.before: Following is a low-cost act of copying or assent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the imperative asks the people to accept an answerable alignment whose traces attach, are recorded, and meet recompense.

strongest_changes: The barrier and blindness sequence turns the city's far edge from mere distance into a source of unblocked movement and perception.
The envoy episode and 36:21-27 turn the man into an endogenous, non-extractive corroborator whose solidarity persists beyond his own outcome.
The repeated single cries, lost capacity, and compelled presentation make يسعى وقال a voluntary action window before movement and speech close.
The recurrence of ر ج ل as witnessing legs at 36:65 makes the man's bodily striving part of his testimony, not merely transport to it.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence linked the focus's city, motion, following, body, and speech at several scales. Most unusually, the same رجل inventory moved from whole person to witnessing legs, while split mappings exposed contained purpose-versus-drift and scarce-voice activations that a conservative reading would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: The social and perceptual force assigned to أقصى may be contrastive activation rather than a property of the literal urban edge.
The civic-steward branches make a coherent mechanism but remain form-distant from the ordinary noun phrases in the focus.
The cosmic-course, drift, scarcity, and liability readings should remain explicit analogical or branch-level resonances rather than lexical substitutions.
